selection.edition: international Adafruit IO HTTP API v2
selection.ownership: Adafruit Industries, New York City, United States. The reviewed edition is the public HTTPS API at io.adafruit.com/api/v2, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Adafruit IO HTTP API v2 (X-AIO-Key header, GET /api/v2/user, GET /api/v2/{username}/feeds, GET /api/v2/{username}/feeds/{feed_key}, GET /api/v2/{username}/feeds/{feed_key}/data), NYC Adafruit Industries identity, and dated incident search for Adafruit IO / Adafruit Industries security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. The 2022-03-04 public GitHub training-dataset disclosure is a historical shop-order PII incident (names/emails/shipping addresses; no passwords or card numbers), remediated the same day; it is not an Adafruit IO API compromise. Data I/O Corp (NASDAQ:DAIO) is a distinct company. No qualifying current unresolved Adafruit IO customer-data compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: Adafruit IO read operations provide current-user, feed inventory, and feed data listing for IoT integrations without write/publish side effects.
exception.incident: 4 March 2022 Adafruit disclosed that an inadvertent private-to-public GitHub repository on or before 2019 exposed an employee-training auditing dataset with some names, email addresses, shipping/billing addresses and/or whether orders succeeded via card processor or PayPal. No passwords or credit-card numbers were in the set. This was Adafruit shop order data, not Adafruit IO API credentials.
exception.remediation: Adafruit deleted the repository within 15 minutes of notification, began forensics, notified affected users, and added access controls for employee-training datasets.
exception.residualRisk: Historical PII exposure for shop customers in the training set. Live Adafruit IO authentication and current security posture are unverified.

research.edition: international Adafruit IO HTTP API v2
research.searchCoverage: Official Adafruit IO v2 at https://io.adafruit.com/api/v2 with X-AIO-Key header auth reviewed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Adafruit Industries, New York. The 2022 GitHub training-dataset disclosure is a historical remediated shop-PII incident under the 2026-09-13 waiver, not an IO platform compromise.

incidents.finding: Inadvertent public GitHub repository exposed a pre-2019 employee-training dataset of some shop names, emails, and shipping/billing addresses. No passwords or card numbers. Repository deleted within 15 minutes of notice.
incidents.limitation: Historical shop-order PII, not Adafruit IO API credentials. This is not a breach-free claim.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /api/v2/user used by the pinned validator.
Native header is official X-AIO-Key. Query-string x-aio-key is not used.
Returns raw Adafruit JSON under data instead of the pinned camelCase user wrapper. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Maps to official GET /api/v2/{username}/feeds. username is a required operation input rather than optional credential-metadata fallback.
Maps to official GET /api/v2/{username}/feeds/{feed_key}. username and feedKey are required path segments and are URL-encoded.
Maps to official GET /api/v2/{username}/feeds/{feed_key}/data with optional start_time, end_time, and limit.
include CSV join is omitted because native query templates cannot express the pinned array-to-comma encoding.
EventOnly webhook for Adafruit IO feed data. No HTTP request.
EventOnly webhook for Adafruit IO reactive/scheduled actions. No HTTP request.
